name: Kurato
source:
He looks energetic and cheerful. After a few accidents and misunderstandings, he is labeled as perverted stalker. He is often lazy and slacks off at almost everything that is appointed to him. At difficult times, he can be serious. His sudden changes makes him an unpredictable character.

[From [url=https://darknights-time.weebly.com/kurato.html]official site[/url]]
